plain.li: [greetings,warm,their:traders] Your letter came up the road with the league's post, {WRITER}, and was read out at the waystation fire. You are on our roads as friends.
[greetings,cordial,their:traders] The league keeps a book of those who deal fairly, {WRITER}. Your colony's name is in it.
[greetings,cool,their:traders] The league has your letter. Trade with us, and we will know you better.
[news,warm,their:traders] Our caravans have been everywhere this season, {WRITER}, and the factors talk. Here is what the road says.
[news,cordial,their:traders] The roads hear everything, and the league hears the roads. What we know, you shall have.
[help,warm,their:traders] The league does not give without a price, as a rule, but it does for friends. What you asked for is coming with our road riders.
[help,cordial,their:traders] It is against the league's custom to give without a price, but the price can wait. It is coming.
[help,refusal,their:traders] The league's stores are spoken for this season, every crate of them. We are sorry for it.
[invitation,warm,their:traders] A league caravan never turns from a gate that is open to it. We will come.
[greetings,warm,their:healers] Your letter was read in the ward tonight, {WRITER}, and the sick were glad of it. The order keeps your colony in its thoughts.
[greetings,cordial,their:healers] The order thanks you for your letter. Our door is open to your people, as it is to everyone's.
[greetings,cool,their:healers] The order has your letter. We tend all who come to us, whatever we think of their colony.
[news,cordial,their:healers] The sick bring news with them, more than they know. Here is what the ward has heard.
[help,warm,medicine,their:healers] The order does not sell what the sick need. What you asked for is on its way with our postulants, freely given.
[help,cordial,their:healers] We have little to spare, but the order gives what it can. It is coming.
[help,refusal,their:healers] Every bed is full and every jar is empty here, {WRITER}. The order has nothing to send, and grieves for it.
[invitation,warm,their:healers] A hospitaller may leave the ward for a day, and we will. Keep a chair by your fire.
[greetings,warm,their:herders] A rider brought your words to our fire, {WRITER}, and the elders were glad of them. The herd is fat and the grass is good.
[greetings,cordial,their:herders] We have your words. The herd moves on soon, but the camp will remember your colony.
[greetings,cool,their:herders] The elders heard your words. The grass will tell us whether they were true.
[news,cordial,their:herders] The herd goes everywhere, and so do we. This is what the grass and the roads have told us.
[help,warm,their:herders] A herder does not count what goes to a friend. It is coming with our riders.
[help,warm,food,their:herders] There is meat and milk enough in a good herd. Some of it is coming to you with our riders.
[help,refusal,their:herders] The winter was long and the herd is thin, {WRITER}. We have nothing to send this season.
[invitation,warm,their:herders] We will come when the herd is settled, and bring a gift from it.
[arrive,their:traders] League road post, signed for at every waystone on the way.
[arrive,their:healers] Peace on this house, the order sent me.
[arrive,their:herders] Our camp is two days back along the grass.
[deliver,silver,their:traders] League coin, and every piece of it good.
[deliver,medicine,their:healers] From the order's own stores, so use them well.
[receive,medicine,their:healers] The ward will have these by tomorrow.
[collect,food,their:herders] The camp will eat well on this.
[leave,their:traders] The road won't wait, and neither will the league.
[leave,their:healers] Back to the ward, they'll be wanting me there.
[leave,their:herders] Back to the herd before dark.
[opt0] A hospitaller of the order saw to my {TALE} today and wouldn't take a coin for it.
[opt0] The order's healer had clean hands and all the patience in the world. The {TALE} is better already.
[opt1] {X_nameDef} saw to my {TALE} with our doctor at the elbow the whole time, and we sent medicine back for their ward.
[opt2] A hospitaller offered to see to my {TALE} and I said no. I'm managing. Mostly.

warm.li: [opt0] Someone from the order came all that way and saw I was hurting. I won't forget it.

gloomy.li: [opt2] The {TALE} again. Sent the hospitaller away. Regretting it.

cold.li: [opt1] The hospitaller's ways were slow but effective. Our doctor took notes.
